purpose: Final consumed-data tuning candidate before the single fresh QA9 holdout. If this candidate misses the frozen gates, stop this line and do not create v2.2/QA9.
principles: A named recipient, company, team or sales department does not by itself make a purpose concrete.
Concrete requires an explicit observable outcome, content, benefit, transaction or specifically named service in the same form text.
Generic contact/help/question wording remains generic when it does not name a specific service or task outcome.
Generic registration, subscription or submission remains generic when no additional outcome is visible.
Try for free without a visible object or creation outcome is ambiguous and remains unknown.
An explicit discount, coupon, benefit or offer is a concrete observable outcome.
Pure technical or structural UI text can be none; semantic text that cannot be resolved remains unknown.
The residual router never emits concrete deterministically. Non-trivial semantic cases are delegated to the intent LLM.

reference_overrides.reason: General help/contact language without a specifically named service outcome; aligns with framework 0.7 and QA7-019.
How can we help / Post Question is a general question/contact action when no topic or service outcome is named.

Talk to a named company is still contact; the recipient is not the purpose outcome.
Sales contact and a general sales question remain generic without a specific quote, demo, appointment or other named service outcome.
